theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q d : ℕ) (L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid Q) (hL : IsProperMap (fun x => (0 : Euclid Q) + L x)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), Isometry L → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity (GeometricCurrentOn.affinePushforward (V := (univ : Set (Euclid Q))) L 0 hL T) ∧ (GeometricCurrentOn.affinePushforward (V := (univ : Set (Euclid Q))) L 0 hL T).mass = T.mass
